name: Gates of Valhalla

features.name: Roaming wild
features.description: After each tumble the wild jumps to a random position and adds up to a 5x multiplier to wins it joins.

features.name: Tumbling reels
features.description: Winning symbols are removed and replaced, allowing consecutive wins.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: Three free spins symbols award up to 10 free spins with an increasing multiplier.

review:
An earlier Pragmatic Norse game with tumbles and a roaming wild instead of multiplier orbs. The wild jumps to a new random spot after every tumble, and when it's part of a win it applies up to 5x – so long chains give it several chances.

Three bonus symbols open up to 10 free spins with a growing multiplier on the total of each spin. More modest than the later mythology hits, with a 5,000x max. 96.46% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
